title: Quiet Firing: 3 Signs Your Boss Wants You Out
hook: Quiet firing: 3 signs you're being pushed out.

scenes.caption: If your boss does these three things in your weekly meetings, you are not being overlooked — you are being quietly managed out.
scenes.caption_roman: If your boss does these three things in your weekly meetings, you are not being overlooked — you are being quietly managed out.

scenes.caption: Sign one: information starvation. Key emails, client updates, and strategic meeting invites quietly stop reaching your inbox.
scenes.caption_roman: Sign one: information starvation. Key emails, client updates, and strategic meeting invites quietly stop reaching your inbox.

scenes.caption: Sign two: shifting goalposts. Deliverables you executed perfectly are suddenly graded against vague, impossible metrics.
scenes.caption_roman: Sign two: shifting goalposts. Deliverables you executed perfectly are suddenly graded against vague, impossible metrics.

scenes.caption: Sign three: calendar isolation. Your 1-on-1s get repeatedly canceled, and high-visibility projects are reassigned to peers.
scenes.caption_roman: Sign three: calendar isolation. Your 1-on-1s get repeatedly canceled, and high-visibility projects are reassigned to peers.

scenes.caption: Corporate psychologists call this constructive dismissal: they pressure you to quit so they avoid severance and unemployment claims.
